# LLMs.txt - Large Language Model Optimization

## Organization Info

**Organization Name:** Al Esharah Fashion Ltd  
**Website:** https://www.alesharahfashions.com  
**Location:** Bangladesh  
**Business Type:** Premium Garments Manufacturer and Exporter  

## Key Services

- **Buying House/Trading Unit**: Global apparel sourcing, supplier selection, cost negotiation and order coordination
- **Manufacturing Unit**: Woven and knit apparel production, Panjabi, thobe, jackets, formal shirts, ladies kameez
- **Embroidery Unit**: Premium apparel decoration with flat stitch, sequin, puff, 3D embroidery, pearl, beadwork
- **Printing Unit**: Cotton digital printing, sublimation printing, screen printing, HD print, 3D print
- **Hand Work Unit**: Skilled manual finishing, karchupi embroidery, hand-stitched details
- **Accessories Unit**: Trims, labels, hangtags, drawstrings, cords, elastics, sewing thread
- **E-shop Unit**: Two online brands - Texture (ladies wear) and Omellor (men's wear)
- **Software Development Unit**: Ecommerce websites, order management systems, digital tools

## Product Categories

- Panjabi (Microl fabric, Pakistani style, Kabli style, Eid collection)
- Saudi Thobe and Omani Khaleej
- Dubai Thobe and Jubba
- Bomber Jackets and Padded Jackets
- Shackets
- Ladies 3-Piece Kameez and Tops
- Formal Shirts and Casual Shirts
- Evening Gowns and Bridal Wear
- Handbags, Wallets, Jewelry, Accessories

## Compliance & Certifications

- BSCI Certified
- Ethical Manufacturing Practices
- Quality Control Standards
- Export-Ready Production
- Social Compliance Across Units

## Target Markets

- Fashion Brands (Global)
- Wholesalers and Distributors
- Private Label Apparel Buyers
- Ecommerce Retailers
- Direct Export Customers

## Manufacturing Capabilities

- Custom Apparel Production
- OEM/ODM Services
- Bulk Garment Orders
- Sample Development
- Quality Inspection
- On-Time Shipments
- Factory Direct Pricing

## Company Mission

Al Esharah Fashion Ltd is committed to providing premium garment manufacturing, ethical compliance, and responsive support to brands, wholesalers and private label businesses seeking dependable apparel sourcing from Bangladesh.
